empty.title: No weigh-ins on this account.
empty.body: This screen reads what Garmin holds. Weigh-ins reach Garmin from a connected scale, from the Connect app, or from an integration. A new weigh-in appears here after the next sync.

empty.title: No food logged in the last 30 days.
empty.body: Garmin returns the eaten side only when something writes it, such as the Connect app log or an integration. Burn comes from your device. Log a day in Garmin Connect and it appears here after the next sync.

empty.title: No strength sessions with set data yet.
empty.body: Sets arrive with a sync, and only for sessions that the watch recorded as strength training. If you lifted recently, the sync has not reached those sessions yet.

strength.caveat: The watch does not record the weight on the bar, so volume here means sets and reps. Exercise names are the watch's guess from wrist motion. The app shows a name only where the watch was confident.
